title: WW3 GPU Lab: hands-on WAVEWATCH III modelling and a C++/Kokkos GPU port
description: A self-paced course and toolkit for the WAVEWATCH III spectral wind-wave model: build and run the Fortran model on real cases, benchmark it, and port its kernels (starting with the W3SNL1 nonlinear interaction source term) to C++/Kokkos with a numerical parity harness against the Fortran reference.
